engagement.name: Pollinations AI — authorized critical-bug assessment
engagement.client: Pollinations maintainers (task owner, holds repository access + permission to test)
engagement.authorization: User states explicit written permission to audit, reproduce and report critical vulnerabilities in the pollinations/pollinations repository and the pollinations.app product surface.
rules_of_engagement: No production DoS / load testing against live endpoints (no flooding, no high-volume amplification tests on production).
No data exfiltration, no modification of real user data, no credential use.
All PoCs are executed against a LOCAL reproduction environment (Cloudflare Workers vitest pool / wrangler local) or against production with a single, minimal, non-destructive request.
No pull requests to the upstream repository; findings are delivered as issue1.md / issue2.md in this repository only.
Only verified, attacker-triggerable, high/critical severity issues are reported; everything else is recorded as non-finding.

targets.location: local reproduction via Cloudflare vitest workers pool (gen.pollinations.ai/test)
local reproduction via Cloudflare vitest workers pool (enter.pollinations.ai/test)
local reproduction via Cloudflare vitest workers pool (media.pollinations.ai/test)

targets.constraints: read-only single requests only; no load, no flooding, no state change
read-only single requests only; no load, no flooding, no state change
read-only single requests only; no load, no flooding, no state change

out_of_scope: Denial-of-service or load testing against production (explicitly prohibited by the engagement rules).
Third-party SaaS providers (e.g. the upstream LLM/image providers) beyond passive observation of how the code calls them.
Social engineering, phishing, physical attacks, denial of service to any shared provider.
